english.title: Knowingly fail to disconnect and seal drains at such points required by local authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having

(A)_[reconstructed a drain that communicated with a sewer,]_
(B)_[reconstructed a drain that communicated with another drain,]_
(C)_[executed works to a drain that communicated with a sewer so as permanently discontinue its use,]_
(D)_[executed works to a drain that communicated with another drain so as to permanently discontinue its use,]
(E)_[executed works on premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) served by a drain that communicated with a sewer so as to permanently discontinue its use,]_
(F)_[executed works on premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) served by a drain that communicated with another drain so as to permanently discontinue its use,]_

knowingly failed to cause

(G)_[that drain,]_
(H)_[a part of that drain,]_

thereby becoming disused or unnecessary, to be disconnected and sealed at the points required by **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62(5) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly fail to cause
drains rendered unnecessary / disused through works in accordance with s.62
to be disconnected and sealed
as required by local authority

english.notes: This section does not apply in relation to anything done in the course of the demolition of a building, or part of a building, being a demolition as respects which the local authority have power under section 81 to serve a notice on the person undertaking the demolition - section 62(6)
